About this blog
My name is Anthony Carr and I am a senior studying Sports Media and Communications at The University of Nebraska-Lincoln. This website was created through a Sports Data Visualization and Analytics class in which we use numerous coding techniques to communicate a story. Growing up as a Minnesota Vikings fan, this seemed like the perfect opportunity to combine data journalism with something meaningful to myself.
